status: Placement screening failed; not a PDN impedance or inductance simulation.
method: Read saved board and filled-zone connectivity without modifying the PCB.
Distances are XY pad-center distances, not routed lengths or electrical loop lengths.
Nearest same-net IC pad may differ from intended functional supply pin where multiple IC supplies share a net.
Via lists are geometrically nearest vias in the same connected island; they do not demonstrate a short local mounting path.
Ground connectivity is membership of the main ground network containing U201.A14.
Only selected SoC/RAM/PMIC shunt capacitors sharing an IC pin net are screened. Inductor-separated output caps, other peripherals, and signal/crystal capacitors are outside these counts.
5 mm is a screening marker, not an Allwinner acceptance limit.
